0022600153.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (4-1, 2nd in the Northwest and 5th in the West) visit the Houston Rockets (5-0, 1st in the Southwest and 1st in the West) in the Thunder's sixth game of the season, with Oklahoma City coming off a loss and Houston riding a five-game winning streak. Oklahoma City will be without Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Chet Holmgren (knee) is listed as day-to-day and a game-time decision, and Houston will be without Reed Sheppard (back) and Steven Adams (calf strain). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Thunder won their 2025-26 season series 2-1, but Houston beat Oklahoma City 112-106 in their last meeting, on February 7, 2026, in Oklahoma City.
